Serpents... ::wheeze:: rule the sea.
Crabs rule... ::sniff:: the sands.
Siphoners rule the... ::cough:: pools.
Creepers - the dark caves... ::wheeze::<end>

segment.target: <end>

segment.source: You have hoppers here?<end>
segment.target: You have hoppers here?<end>

segment.source: Uh... yeah. ::He nods, wheezing.:: They've been brought here a long time ago... ::wheeze:: 'cause they're easy to keep. But they... ::sniff:: kept dyin' in captivity. ::wheeze:: It's us, I guess. So we let them inhabit the surroundin' lands... ::wheeze::<end>

segment.source: They haven't spread far, though. ::wheeze:: Lotsa hungry critters 'round here.<end>
segment.target: They haven't spread far, though. ::wheeze:: Lotsa hungry critters 'round here.<end>

segment.source: Forget I said anythin'. <end>
segment.target: Forget I said anythin'. <end>

segment.source: ::Wheeze::<end>
segment.target: ::Wheeze::<end>

segment.source: Tell me about the crabs.<end>
segment.target: Tell me about the crabs.<end>

segment.source: Burrow under the... ::wheeze:: sand. Then they... ::sniff:: burst out to getcha. The big buggers do... ::wheeze:: the small ones can't hurt you.<end>
segment.target: Burrow under the... ::wheeze:: sand. Then they... ::sniff:: burst out to getcha. The big buggers do... ::wheeze:: the small ones can't hurt you.<end>

segment.source: But the big ones... some can even zap ya. ::wheeze:: BzzZzz! And you're... ::cough:: dead.<end>
segment.target: But the big ones... some can even zap ya. ::wheeze:: BzzZzz! And you're... ::cough:: dead.<end>

segment.source: These serpents...<end>
segment.target: These serpents...<end>

segment.source: Dangerous. They ain't got the taste for us... ::wheeze:: luckily, so they don't linger... ::sniff:: around this island.<end>
segment.target: Dangerous. They ain't got the taste for us... ::wheeze:: luckily, so they don't linger... ::sniff:: around this island.<end>

segment.source: But they love... ::wheeze:: <end>
segment.target: But they love... ::wheeze:: <end>

segment.source: your friends on... ::cough:: jets. <end>
segment.target: your friends on... ::cough:: jets. <end>

segment.source: Pirates... ::wheeze:: too. They're fast... and got a real nasty bite. ::wheeze:: All of 'em.<end>
segment.target: Pirates... ::wheeze:: too. They're fast... and got a real nasty bite. ::wheeze:: All of 'em.<end>

segment.source: the newcomers on... ::cough:: jets. <end>
segment.target: the newcomers on... ::cough:: jets. <end>

segment.source: Your mates too.<end>
segment.target: Your mates too.<end>

segment.source: What can you tell me about the local siphoners?<end>
segment.target: What can you tell me about the local siphoners?<end>

segment.source: There are lesser ones... ::wheeze:: and there are greater ones... Pretty much the same things other than size... ::wheeze:: The greater ones taste a bit better, though. <end>
segment.target: There are lesser ones... ::wheeze:: and there are greater ones... Pretty much the same things other than size... ::wheeze:: The greater ones taste a bit better, though. <end>

segment.source: Or so they... ::wheeze:: told me. I can't taste nothin'.<end>
segment.target: Or so they... ::wheeze:: told me. I can't taste nothin'.<end>

segment.source: Creepers?<end>
segment.target: Creepers?<end>

segment.source: Giant spiders. ::wheeze:: Web-weavin' buggers. Their venom can blind... ::wheeze:: you.<end>
segment.target: Giant spiders. ::wheeze:: Web-weavin' buggers. Their venom can blind... ::wheeze:: you.<end>

segment.source: There's a nest nearby... ::wheeze:: They moved in to eat... ::wheeze:: our hoppers. Huge nest... ::wheeze:: underground.<end>
segment.target: There's a nest nearby... ::wheeze:: They moved in to eat... ::wheeze:: our hoppers. Huge nest... ::wheeze:: underground.<end>

segment.source: Let me ask you something else.<end>
segment.target: Let me ask you something else.<end>

segment.source: I have no more questions.<end>
segment.target: I have no more questions.<end>

segment.source: Wouldn't know... ::wheeze::<end>
segment.target: Wouldn't know... ::wheeze::<end>

segment.source: This is the... ::sniff:: most borin' part of the Black Sea... ::wheeze:: for sure.<end>
segment.target: This is the... ::sniff:: most borin' part of the Black Sea... ::wheeze:: for sure.<end>

segment.source: About the surrounding areas...<end>
segment.target: About the surrounding areas...<end>

segment.source: Questions? ::wheeze::<end>
segment.target: Questions? ::wheeze::<end>

segment.source: That monolith at the entrance, what do you know about it?<end>
segment.target: That monolith at the entrance, what do you know about it?<end>

segment.source: It's been there since we... ::wheeze:: came. Ain't got the faintest what it... ::sniff:: is or does. <end>
segment.target: It's been there since we... ::wheeze:: came. Ain't got the faintest what it... ::sniff:: is or does. <end>

segment.source: Heard plenty of stories... ::wheeze:: But I don't know. However... ::sniff:: the Serpentines... they fear it. ::wheeze:: Scares the... ::sniff:: crap outta them.<end>
segment.target: Heard plenty of stories... ::wheeze:: But I don't know. However... ::sniff:: the Serpentines... they fear it. ::wheeze:: Scares the... ::sniff:: crap outta them.<end>

segment.source: How come?<end>
segment.target: How come?<end>

segment.source: They avoid it like leprosy... ::sniff:: even cover their eyes as to not look at it. ::wheeze:: And if the currents bring their boats close... ::sniff:: they start frantically rowin'... ::wheeze:: back. You can just see it. Frantically, yeah. ::cough::<end>
